annotations.title: Read or search the North Carolina (NC) Constitution

description:
The North Carolina (NC) Constitution — read a section by citation, list an article, or
search it by topic.

Use for "what does the NC Constitution say about ..." and for any "N.C. Const." citation.
Give `citation` ("N.C. Const. art. I, § 20", "Article I, Section 20", "Art. IX, sec. 2",
"Section 20 of Article I") or `article` + `section`; an article alone ("Article IV")
lists its sections. Give `query` instead to search the text by topic.

A section returns its heading, text, the statutes that cite it, and when ncleg's text
last changed. Amendments awaiting a referendum are printed by ncleg as two versions —
"(Effective until contingency met)" and "(Effective once contingency met)" — and come
back as `variants`, the one in force first, with ncleg's note on the contingency.

This is ncleg's online text, not an official certified copy, and it carries no
amendment history: stored versions begin with the first crawl. For the U.S. Constitution
this server has nothing; for statutes use get_statute.

article.description: Article number, Roman or Arabic, with or without `section`.

citation.description: A section or article of the NC Constitution in any common form.

limit.description: With `query`: maximum number of sections to return (1-25).

max_chars.description: Cut each section's text at this many characters (default 12000). A cut is flagged `truncated`.

query.description: Topic search across the Constitution when there is no citation.

name: get_constitution
